items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of exemption
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Nordmuster, Kreishaus, Marktstraße 1, 25813 Musterwik. Wird der Bescheid mit der Post verschickt, ist er nach dem Landesverwaltungsverfahrensrecht am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post bekannt gegeben.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 2025-09-01, presumed handed to post that day. Per the letter's stated rule, Bekanntgabe (deemed delivery) occurs on the 4th day after posting: Sept 1 + 4 days = Fri 2025-09-05 (day of posting not counted, days 1-4 = Sep2,3,4,5). The one-month Widerspruch period begins with Bekanntgabe as the triggering event; under §187(1) BGB the event day itself is excluded, so the period runs from Sat 2025-09-06 and ends, per §188(2) BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the event day (Sept 5) → Sun 2025-10-05. Since that day is a Sunday, under §193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day, Mon 2025-10-06 (no intervening SH public holiday).

warnings: The exact posting date (Aufgabe zur Post) is assumed to be the same as the letter's document date (2025-09-01); if the letter was actually posted on a later day, the deemed-delivery date and thus the Widerspruch deadline shift accordingly.

The letter states the deemed-delivery period as 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post', which differs from the commonly cited 3-day rule under federal VwVfG; this figure from the Land's administrative procedure law was taken as given and not independently re-verified.
